name: Voice
description: Produce local speech output through the configured OpenZero voice stack. Use when the user asks OpenZero to speak, read text aloud, produce a local voice reply, or test text-to-speech.
risk_summary: Local playback is allowed when requested; sensitive speech and external distribution are not implied.
summary: Speak bounded text locally through the configured voice engine and report the actual engine result.

required_evidence: Report whether the local voice engine returned success and the output path when available.
stop_when: The requested text is spoken once.
No configured local voice engine is available.

limitations: Speech generation does not authorize posting or sending the audio.
A configured voice profile may be unavailable on another node.
